--- create_property_graph_options.sql
CREATE PROPERTY GRAPH g NODE TABLES (T)
OPTIONS (validate_element_key_uniqueness = false)

--- AST
&ast.CreatePropertyGraph{
  Name: &ast.Ident{
    NamePos: 22,
    NameEnd: 23,
    Name:    "g",
  },
  Content: &ast.PropertyGraphContent{
    NodeTables: &ast.PropertyGraphNodeTables{
      Node:   24,
      Tables: &ast.PropertyGraphElementList{
        Lparen:   36,
        Rparen:   38,
        Elements: []*ast.PropertyGraphElement{
          &ast.PropertyGraphElement{
            Name: &ast.Ident{
              NamePos: 37,
              NameEnd: 38,
              Name:    "T",
            },
          },
        },
      },
    },
  },
  Options: &ast.Options{
    Options: 40,
    Rparen:  88,
    Records: []*ast.OptionsDef{
      &ast.OptionsDef{
        Name: &ast.Ident{
          NamePos: 49,
          NameEnd: 80,
          Name:    "validate_element_key_uniqueness",
        },
        Value: &ast.BoolLiteral{
          ValuePos: 83,
        },
      },
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
CREATE PROPERTY GRAPH g NODE TABLES (T) OPTIONS (validate_element_key_uniqueness = false)
